knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The therapist cannot diagnose a rash. The advised action is to postpone, refer and record the decision.
Where the product instructions require a patch test, it must be carried out and recorded. A past service does not replace it.
The lesson lists an open wound, a skin infection, a recent reaction to a product and a skin condition the therapist cannot assess as common examples. An open wound is one of them.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate complete an intake review with a simulated client who has a stated contraindication, and postpone the treatment with a referral record
Assessor observes the candidate carry out a patch test following the product instructions, and record product, site, time applied, time read, result and response
Assessor checks that the consent record is completed and dated before the simulated treatment starts
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Intake form for the simulated client with answers recorded
Patch test record with the six required fields
Consent record dated before the treatment
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate proceeds with a treatment where a contraindication is present and unresolved
The candidate skips a patch test that the product instructions require
The candidate starts the treatment with no consent recorded
